summary: Iteration 7 verified the 4 new features requested: (A) Calendario Colturale, (B) Report PDF, (C) Telegram notifications (chat_id-only config path + graceful 400 error handling with no bot token), (D) Ciclo Automatico toggle. Backend suite extended from 42 -> 53 pytests, ALL 53 PASSING (100%) in ~70s. New tests: TestCalendar (4), TestReport (2), TestTelegram (2), TestAutoCycleConfig (3). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; /calendario shows all 7 group buttons (cal-group-pomacee..avocado) and 12 cal-month cards, switching group re-renders 12; /report renders report-content with counts + Piante/Trattamenti/Concimazioni sections + print-report-btn; /impostazioni Telegram card (cfg-telegram + test-telegram) correctly triggers backend 400 (never 500) both when chat_id empty and when chat_id set but bot token empty — 'Bot Telegram non configurato' toast displayed. toggle-auto flips visually and PERSISTS across full page reload. Regression: full 53-test suite still 100% green (login, plants+auto-BBCH, treatments, cycle engine, recommendations, alerts, weather, irrigation, fertilization CRUD/edit, diagnosis, workplan, phase-advice, config).

action_items: None blocking. All 4 requested features (Calendar / Report / Telegram / Auto-cycle) work end-to-end. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN still empty as expected — real message sending cannot be tested until user provides a token; the error path is verified to return clean 400 (never 500).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/calendar/groups returns 7 groups with key/label/emoji. GET /api/calendar/{group} returns 12 months with month/name/operations, and unknown group falls back to pomacee (calendar_data.calendar_for). Cleanly auth-guarded.

GET /api/report: correctly aggregates plants (with phase name resolution), treatments (top 50), fertilizations (top 50), diagnoses (top 30). counts dict is present. owner uses user.name. generated_at is iso. Frontend Report.jsx handles empty arrays gracefully.

POST /api/telegram/test: verifies chat_id first -> HTTPException(400) with 'Inserisci prima la tua Chat ID'; then _send_telegram returns (False, 'Bot Telegram non configurato...') when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is empty, endpoint raises HTTPException(400, f'Invio non riuscito: {msg}'). Correctly returns 400 for both cases — no 500.
PUT /api/config: merge semantics preserve other keys when partial values are sent (verified by test that toggles auto_cycle_enabled without touching other keys and confirms via GET).

Background auto_cycle loop: _auto_cycle_loop registered as asyncio.create_task in startup, sleeps 30s then queries configs where values.auto_cycle_enabled='true' every hour. Backend startup is clean (login endpoint responsive after startup). Not blocking, no crash.
notify_cycle only fires when result contains new_recommendations/leached/fertilization_reminders or fungal_risk>=3 — good filter.

MINOR: _send_telegram uses parse_mode='HTML' — if user's chat_id turns out invalid the description string is passed straight through to toast; consider a friendlier error for common 'chat not found' cases.
MINOR: Calendar frontend swallows API errors via .catch(() => {}), which hides 401s; not critical since ProtectedRoute already guards navigation.
MINOR: Report is loaded once on mount; consider adding a Refresh button (window.print re-fetches nothing, but users adding data mid-session need to reload).
